title: Grateful Dead Live at Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05

ai_review.summary: Solid early‑morning US Festival show with a smoking Playin’→Shakedown sequence and strong Minglewood, captured on a good soundboard despite occasional piano distortion.
ai_review.review: The performance is remembered for its energetic opening of Playing in the Band into Shakedown Street, a fiery Minglewood Blues, and one of the best China Cat Sunflower / I Know You Rider transitions of the Brent era. Reviewers note that the soundboard source is generally clear and enjoyable, though a few point out piano distortion on Shakedown and occasional mix quirks. Overall the show delivers high‑energy playing that outweighs the minor technical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and praise both the musical performance (standout songs, high energy) and recording quality (good soundboard with only minor issues), leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and clear; a few reviewers mention slight waviness, Brent's piano sounding distorted on Shakedown, and occasional mix wonkiness where Phil drops out briefly.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening with Playin' into Shakedown, followed by a tight Minglewood and an excellent China/Rider transition; the set maintains momentum despite the early‑morning heat.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Melts into Shakedown quickly with solid guitar tone throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass work is solid; a few reviewers note his presence fades in the mix and he pushes the PA during the space segment.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's piano on Shakedown is reported as distorted, but otherwise keyboards are well‑balanced.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums > encore highlighted as a highlight; energetic and tight.
